_asserts: With no `limits` array, `seven_day_sonnet` and `seven_day_opus` fall back the same way `five_hour`/`seven_day` do — caps must not silently vanish on a server-side rollback of the `limits` shape (CCM-45, Android's CCBG-8).
Fallback caps are named "Sonnet" and "Opus", in that order — the flat keys carry no display_name.
Only those two flat keys are read; any other `seven_day_*` sibling would be a guess.
serverSeverity is null — legacy blocks carry no severity; NORMAL derives from the percents.
The fallback fills caps only when the `limits` array produced none.
